x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/specification_sections?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Bid%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&sort=SOME_STRING_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"specification_section\":{\"number\":\"15\",\"description\":\"Mechanical\",\"specification_section_division_id\":3001}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/specification_sections?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
